title: 第一卷 第113章 两头同时出事
slug: 重生1989我一赌鬼带全家顿顿吃肉
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“有人在暗地里散播咱们百味鲜虾馆的谣言，说有人吃坏了事，闹肚子都上医院了。”

“这事传的沸沸扬扬，有好几个咱们之前的老顾客，因为这，都不敢过来买了。”

听到这话，王建军的脸瞬间便沉了下来。

他就说，今天怎么生意这么差，原来问题出现在了这里！

“王兄弟，你说咱们该怎么办？”

“这龙虾，咱们自己人都吃多少次了，一点事都没有，怎么他们吃了就闹肚子了？”

郝大能急的那是额头直冒汗，一点招都没有，甚至想着要不要做点什么，挽救一下如今的情况。

总不能任由这谣言继续发酵下去啊！

但王建军此时却十分冷静，甚至可以说冷静的可怕。

他直接开口，打破了郝大能的那些想法。

“不用，咱们不需要自证，只需要把这散播谣言的人抓住，或者顺着他们看看到底是谁在背后搞鬼！”

王建军眼神中闪过一抹精光，胸有成竹的说道。

可郝大能还是觉得什么都不做，有点太草率了，忍不住说道。

“这人，咱们肯定是要抓的，不过咱们要不要也做点什么？”

“比如谁要是吃坏事了，咱们带他去医院，或者咱们做出保证，咱的龙虾一定没问题的，我怕那些人听到这些谣言，以后都不敢来了。”

郝大能不安的说着。

他的担心确实不无道理，因为今天明显来买龙虾的人就少了。

可王建军却摇了摇头，淡定的说道。

“郝大哥，你要知道咱们的龙虾是一定没问题的。”

“一旦做出了保证，万一他们再借这事生事，故意让人吃坏了肚子，污蔑到咱们头上呢？”

王建军轻描淡写的说着这话，让郝大能一下子冷汗直流。

是啊，他怎么没想到这事呢！

还好他没有擅自做主，要不然回头真出了事，给他们百味鲜虾馆惹了麻烦，他罪过可就大了。

“怪我，怪我，这事怪我考虑的不周到。”

郝大能一边说着，一边擦着额头上的冷汗。

他真是差点着了那些人的道了。

要不是有王建军提点，估计他都傻乎乎的跳进去了。

“是他们太狡诈了，而且清者自清，咱们不需要自证，那些爱吃的人自然会来买的。”

"Someone is secretly spreading rumors about our Baiwei Shrimp Restaurant, saying that someone had a bad meal and went to the hospital because of stomach upset."

"This matter has spread so much that several of our old customers are afraid to come over and buy because of this."

Upon hearing this, Wang Jianjun's face instantly sank.

He said, why is business so bad today? It turns out that the problem lies here!

"Brother Wang, what do you think we should do?"

“这龙虾，咱们自己人都吃多少次了，一点事都没有，怎么他们吃了就闹肚子了？”

Hao Daneng was so anxious that he was sweating profusely on his forehead, and he had no idea what to do. He even thought about whether he should do something to save the current situation.

We cannot allow this rumor to continue to ferment!

But Wang Jianjun was very calm at this time, even terrifyingly calm.

He spoke directly, breaking Hao Daneng's thoughts.

"No, we don't need to prove ourselves. We just need to catch the people spreading rumors, or follow them to find out who is behind it!"

A glint flashed in Wang Jianjun's eyes and he said confidently.

But Hao Daneng still felt that doing nothing was a bit too hasty, so he couldn't help but say.

“这人，咱们肯定是要抓的，不过咱们要不要也做点什么？”

"For example, if someone eats something bad, we take him to the hospital, or we make a guarantee that our lobster will be fine. I'm afraid those people will not dare to come here in the future after hearing these rumors."

Hao Daneng said uneasily.

His worries are indeed justified, because there are obviously fewer people coming to buy lobsters today.

But Wang Jianjun shook his head and said calmly.

"Brother Hao, you have to know that our lobsters are definitely fine."

"Once a guarantee is made, what if they use this to cause trouble again, deliberately upset people's stomachs, and slander us?"

王建军轻描淡写的说着这话，让郝大能一下子冷汗直流。

Yes, why didn't he think of this?

Fortunately, he didn't make the decision without permission. Otherwise, if something happened later and caused trouble for their Baiwei Shrimp Restaurant, he would be guilty of a great crime.

"Blame me, blame me, blame me for not thinking carefully about this matter."

Hao Daneng said while wiping the cold sweat on his forehead.

He really almost fell into the trap of those people.

If it weren't for Wang Jianjun's suggestion, he would have jumped in stupidly.

"They are too cunning, and those who are clean will clean themselves up. We don't need to prove ourselves. Those who love food will naturally come to buy it."
